then.text: You got to the hollow! Most people stop at the water and ask if there's a cafe. There is, but that's not the point.
Jack McGann's dog never had it this good. He found the cave in 1944 and the dog found it first.
Gate's open. Down the steps, then follow the water. The passage floods, but there is a sluice wheel on the near bank.

Bring a lantern: some things only show in proper light. At the bottom there is a bear's hollow behind a slab. Roll the boulder onto the plate, in straight lines. If it sticks, step out and in again. The cave tidies itself.

else.text: Welcome to Aillwee. Mind your head, mind the drips, and don't touch the stalactites. They are older than your gran.
The gate to the steps is locked from my side. There's a big iron lever by the table. Give it a good heave.
